921.desc: This magma-like ore can only be handled by trained hands.

922.desc: This craftsman's dream can be combined to produce many colors and properties.

923.desc: A species of carp most frequently seen during springtime.

924.desc: This insect is an artisan, using sticky body fluids and sharp jaws to great effect.

925.desc: This craftsman's dream can be combined to produce many colors and properties.

926.desc: An insect with a giant horn, a massive shell, and wings of butterfly-like beauty.

927.desc: A giant insect with a very hard shell. Protects crops by eating harmful pests.

928.desc: This item, dropped by a Shakalaka, looks like trash, but is highly treasured.

929.desc: Dropped by a King Shakalaka. For an item owned by royalty it looks like... trash...

930.desc: This scale camouflages you in the snow, allowing you to approach your prey unseen.

931.desc: A scale ripped from a Giaprey. Used to craft excellent equipment.

932.desc: A hide stripped of its scales. Its classy color is very popular.

933.desc: The hide of a Giadrome. It bears the scars of a pack leader's battles.

934.desc: Sharper than a Giaprey claw, touching it bare-handed is quite dangerous.

935.desc: This sharp claw is the deadly weapon of choice for Giadrome pack leaders.

936.desc: The large crest of this Giadrome skull marks it out as that of a pack leader.

937.desc: A cloth discovered by the king of an ancient desert land. Feels sinister.

938.desc: A stone with the power of an unknown civilization. (Account Item)

939.desc: Frost from a steel dragon that will not melt. Its chill is used in weapons.

940.desc: A fossilized steel dragon scale. Very cold frost forms on it at night.

941.desc: Soft and clay-like, this looks like a Khezu stone, but is in fact a rare ore.

942.desc: Very hard to get hold of, this mushroom is packed with a slimy liquid.

943.desc: Predatory bug. Squirts a foam that's impossible to scrape off.

944.desc: Predatory fish that attacks prey above the surface by squirting water from sacs.

945.desc: An ore that forms the base of a polish that's used for all sorts of metals.

946.desc: A ticket received for taking part in the Decor Derby. Try collecting them!

947.desc: A ticket received for taking part in the Decor Derby+. Try collecting them!

948.desc: Fluids of the Thunderbug. Can cause an electrical surge when stockpiled.

949.desc: Its spores make monsters hallucinate when inhaled, causing total chaos.

950.desc: A monster organ filled with a potent toxin. Dangerous even to touch.

951.desc: A monster organ filled with powder that ignites when exposed to air.

952.desc: A monster organ that contains a strong electrical charge.

953.desc: Top-quality monster bone. Hard to find, but vital for crafting tough equipment.

954.desc: The stout bone of a brutish monster. An easy material to work with.

955.desc: A hard monster bone. Its rigidity makes it priceless for crafting.

956.desc: A rare and priceless gem formed when a hairball hardens inside a Felyne.

957.desc: A majestic Bulldrome Tusk. Its damaged surface tells of many hard-fought battles.

958.desc: A lovely material to touch. Difficult to carve, but valued by the Guild.

959.desc: A high-quality Giaprey Hide. It should allow the crafting of some sturdy gear.

960.desc: A high-quality descaled Velociprey hide. A very versatile material.

961.desc: A high-quality descaled Genprey hide. Capable of neutralizing neurotoxins.

962.desc: This supple tail has evolved hard scales to survive in harsh desert conditions.

963.desc: A high-quality descaled Ioprey hide. Its red skin resists poison.

964.desc: A superior Kut-Ku scale. A cut above in both size and weight.

965.desc: A superior Blue Kut-Ku scale. Its complex blue color is the height of cool.

966.desc: This white pelt is perfect for protecting the body against mountain cold.

967.desc: Harder to work with than normal Blango Pelt, but has high value as a material.

968.desc: Conga fur. Solid and pleasant to the touch.

969.desc: The hard pelt of a Conga. The thick fur makes for long-lasting equipment.

970.desc: A beautiful upper fin. Its spikes are filled with a potent neurotoxin.

971.desc: This high-quality scale from a Green Plesioth has a very eye-catching color.

972.desc: A high-quality fin from a Green Plesioth. Easy to work with, and widely used.

973.desc: Heat-producing bodily fluids from a fire wyvern. Useful in equipment crafting.

974.desc: An organ made available by new carving techniques. Very difficult to work with.

975.desc: A pink ore found near the tear ducts of a Basarios. Looks just like a jewel.

976.desc: A Gravios brain stem is precious, but very difficult to work with.

977.desc: The hard shell of a Black Diablos is impervious to harsh desert winds.

978.desc: The hard part of a Hornetaur shell. Exhibits special properties when crafted.

979.desc: A deep-red scale that rivals a carapace when it comes to hardness.

980.desc: Hardened by time, this carapace is even tougher than metal.

981.desc: Shell from a Gaoren's spine. Gives it the appearance of an impregnable fortress.

982.desc: Wing webbing carved from a Fire Dragon. A marvelous material with myriad uses.

983.desc: Its mysterious effects can increase the quality of any item.

984.desc: This shining Dragonwood can produce some eye-poppingly impressive equipment.

985.desc: A scale from an incredibly violent Tigrex. Bulky and incredibly tough.

986.desc: A flawless Tigrex scale. Harder than steel when interlocked.

987.desc: A hard Tigrex shell, capable of repelling any impact. Shockingly tough.

988.desc: Hardened by the sands of time, its edges indicate a Tigrex's ferocity.

989.desc: Top-quality equipment can be made from this strong and supple tail.

990.desc: A distinctive forelimb claw, not seen on other wyverns. Fiendishly sharp.

991.desc: Sharpened by the sands of time--and by the blood of its victims.

992.desc: No one can hide their fear of this terrible fang, sharpened by pain itself.

993.desc: The sharp fangs of a Tigrex can cut any prey to shreds.

994.desc: The skull of a violent Tigrex. Just as dreadful in death as in life.

995.desc: A faintly glittering Akantor Scale. It will not melt, even if dipped in lava.

996.desc: A shining Akantor Shell. Exceptionally hard, and thus difficult to craft.

997.desc: The large, rock-like tail of an Akantor. Strong enough to gouge the earth.

998.desc: A hard Akantor Claw that can smash bedrock. Its victims are left unrecognizable.

999.desc: A huge fang that slices through the sky--and through its victims.
